content.title: 65,000+ Hours with the Holy Qur’an!
content.subtitle: You are also a part of this incredible journey.
content.body:
Alhamdulillah! In the past month, 263,291 Muslims Day users used at least one feature of the Qur’an section.

In total, more than 65,000 hours were spent using various Qur’an features in one month. Of this, 2,077 hours were spent reading Tafsir and understanding the Qur’an.

A part of this huge number is your time too. When you read a verse of the Qur’an on Muslims Day, viewed its translation, read Tafsir, or used any Qur’an feature, you also became a part of this huge community.

You are also a part of this journey

Being a small part of this beautiful journey of so many people connecting with the Qur’an is a great blessing for us. We are grateful to Allah for this. And we are sincerely grateful to everyone who uses Muslims Day every day.

Many of our users say in their reviews and feedback that the Muslims Day team is truly fortunate to be involved in helping so many people spend time with the Qur’an. They also wish they could be a part of this good work!

You can also be a part of this service

It is to honor this desire that we have created an opportunity for you.

We want to stay connected with the Qur’an every day and do something good every day. Likewise, if our small contribution becomes regular, it too can become a beautiful act of worship.

You can support Muslims Day’s Qur’an-based work every day. Once activated, your support will continue automatically every day as your small daily contribution. May Allah accept you in the service of the Qur’an.

footer_button.hint: If you wish, you can start a daily contribution with a small amount. Your contribution will automatically reach its destination every day.
